payload.title: Working with `Pandas`
payload.summary: This notebook demonstrates the integration of Pandas with Pyleoclim for handling paleoclimate data. It covers exporting Pyleoclim Series to Pandas Series, unit conversions, time series selection, CSV import/export, and resampling. The notebook also explores handling MultipleSeries objects with Pandas, including exporting to DataFrames and aligning data to a common time axis.
goals: Learn to export Pyleclim `Series` to Pandas `Series`.
Select portions of a time series based on time or value criteria
techniques: Aligning data to a common axis

section_blurbs.blurb: Introduction to the integration of Pandas with Pyleoclim, highlighting the limitations of Pandas in paleogeosciences and the goals of the notebook.
section_blurbs.heading: Working with `Pandas`

section_blurbs.blurb: Demonstrates exporting a Pyleoclim Series to a Pandas Series and applying Pandas methods to it.
section_blurbs.heading: .to_pandas()

section_blurbs.blurb: Explains how Pyleoclim handles date string semantics for enhanced time representation conversions.
section_blurbs.heading: Unit conversions

section_blurbs.blurb: Shows how to use Pandas semantics to select specific values from a paleoclimate dataset.
section_blurbs.heading: Selection

section_blurbs.blurb: Describes the process of exporting and importing data to and from CSV files using Pandas.
section_blurbs.heading: CSV Import/Export

section_blurbs.blurb: Covers the resampling of time series data to different temporal resolutions using Pyleoclim's resample function.
section_blurbs.heading: Resampling

section_blurbs.blurb: Explains how to handle MultipleSeries objects with Pandas, including exporting to DataFrames and aligning data.
section_blurbs.heading: Pandas operations with MultipleSeries objects

section_blurbs.blurb: Concludes with the benefits of integrating Pandas within Pyleoclim for data processing and visualization.
section_blurbs.heading: Summary
